input.periods: unique period_id and source assertion_id; system, level, own lord, parent_id, start/end, scenario_id and ayanamsha_id, sigma_boundary, dossier, mechanism_conditions keyed by declared mechanism_id; each condition carries participant_conditions, commencement_condition, effective_state and coverage; no convergence dependency
input.negative_space: one evaluated negative-space assertion per judge assertion; target_assertion_id, assertion_id, effective_state, coverage, source and provenance; missing row yields unavailable with negative_space_mapping_missing, never an active default
input.jury: unique assertion_id; event_class and interval, D(W) nullable, witness_signature, segment_support, coverage and provenance; overlaps retained individually without scores or probability conversion
input.contexts: unique assertion_id; event_class, start/end, kind=coverage_gap|clock_only|uncomputed_method; coverage, reason, source and provenance; visible without judge windows
input.forecaster: optional typed assertions: event_class, interval, alignment_surprise with null_reason, coverage, source and provenance; explicit forecaster upstream pin required when present; preserve signed/zero values separately, never convert to composite or probability
input.lel: event_id, period_id, role, used_for_selection, source and provenance; role=explains and used_for_selection=false only; selection/scoring/outcome use is excluded
